notes: Per-pair frequency record mandated by the Lead-Grid Frequency Standard (adopted 2026-07-14) § 'Enforcement'. For every REGISTERED pair (one entry per app/pair_configs/*_config.py) this records the SIGNAL's native release frequency, its publication lag, the lead axis that frequency implies (Step 1 HARD RULE), and the anchored grid (Step 3). scripts/gate_lead_axis.py asserts each pair's lead artifacts (lead tournament CSV, lead_sharpe_distribution chart, lead_correlation) sit on the axis recorded here. The load-bearing check: a DAILY-signal pair must NOT carry a MONTHLY-axis lead chart (the hy_ig class of error). signal_frequency is the classification of record; observed_winner_lead_unit is the winner_summary.lead_unit at authoring time, kept as an audit cross-check. lead_floor / publication_lag are REFERENCE metadata (Step 2 real-time floor) and are NOT gate-enforced — the gate checks AXIS ONLY, never selection windows/caps/floors. Archived pairs (*_archived) and superseded versions (hy_ig_spy_v1) are intentionally excluded: not registered, not deployed. DEBT FLAG: the 4 daily Class-A pairs currently carry a MONTHLY-axis lead tournament + chart (a monthly L0-12 resample bolted onto a daily-traded winner); they are recorded here as 'daily' and are EXPECTED to FAIL the gate until rebuilt on the daily axis (rollout item 1). t10y3m_spy and petrol_inv_spy derive from higher-frequency native sources but are processed and deployed end-to-end on a monthly axis; they are recorded as 'monthly' (internally coherent) and flagged for the item-3 monthly re-validation.
